'''"Missing the Mannett Point: The Mantellian Civil War Revealed"''' was a [[Holobook/Legends|holobook]] documentary by holojournalist [[Lamalla Rann]] about the [[Separatist War]], a civil war that embroiled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]. Rann's documentary became the best-selling non-fiction work of the year.<ref name="Interview" />
